scope.en: Seven unique-mutation projects: the clone threshold for five space-fauna kinds and the kill rewards for the Elder Tiyanki and the Voidspawn, each with its project and result.

texts.zh:
在我们对新克隆生物进行训练的过程中，一只受伤的太空变形虫使用了一种新技术击败了对手。变形虫的鞭毛能够从训练伙伴的天然防御中吸取营养和物质，用它们来修补自身盔甲上的漏洞，并恢复战斗力。

对这种现象的进一步研究可能会揭示太空变形虫生物学的一个新元素，可以对其进行增强，从而开发出一种新的物种特异性突变。
texts.en:
During our training process of newly cloned organisms, an injured Space Amoeba used a novel technique to defeat its opponent. The Amoeba's flagella were able to siphon nutrients and materials from its training partner's natural defenses, using them to patch holes in their own armor and regain fighting strength.

Additional research into this phenomenon may reveal a new element of Space Amoeba biology that can be enhanced to develop a new species-specific mutation.

title.zh: 太空变形虫变异计划完成

texts.zh:
我们关于空间变形虫的变异实验完成了，得到了一些有趣的新细胞器：可部署的吸血鞭毛。

这些共生生物能够从附近物体中汲取能量并将其返还给宿主，从而增强生存能力和再生能力。
texts.en:
Our experimental mutation project on Space Amoebas is complete, and has yielded some interesting new organelles: deployable Leechcraft.

These symbiotic organisms are able to drain energy from nearby objects and return it to its host, enhancing survivability and regeneration.

texts.zh:
最近克隆的一支缇扬奇舰队被观察到正在进行交流，反复发出复杂的叫声。这些几乎无法察觉的声音似乎给附近的所有其他生物带来了安慰和平静。

对这种现象的进一步研究可能会揭示缇扬奇生物学的一个新元素，可以增强该元素以开发出特定物种的突变。
texts.en:
A recently cloned fleet of Tiyanki were observed communing together, repeatedly emitting a series of complex vocalizations. The barely detectable sounds seemed to bring comfort and calm to every other creature nearby.

Additional research into this phenomenon may reveal a new element of Tiyanki biology that can be enhanced to develop a species-specific mutation.

texts.zh:
我们对缇扬奇的变异实验完成了，得到了一个有趣的结果：群兽合唱

我们已经将这些生物在它们群体中用于交流的自然振动放大到可持续的最大水平。这将产生一个可控的场，增强附近其他生物的组织。
texts.en:
Our experimental mutation project on Tiyankis is complete, and has yielded some interesting enhancements: Herdsong Chords

We have amplified the natural vibrations these creatures use for communication within their herds to the maximum sustainable level. This results in a controllable field that strengthens the tissue of other nearby creatures.

texts.zh: 我们对[From.GetShipCategoryName]的克隆工作取得了基因突破。将这些生物独特的解剖结构与我们在基因操控方面的专业知识结合起来，或许可以创造出一种独特的变异体。

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这类生物的类别名称。
note.en: In the game, the category name of this creature appears here.

texts.zh:
我们注意到一些虚空虫在成熟时会形成小的囊肿状生长物。进一步观察表明，带有这些难看水泡的样本通常比它们的同类更具繁殖力。

对这种现象的进一步研究可能会揭示虚空虫生物学的一个新元素，可以增强该元素以开发出特定物种的突变。
texts.en:
We have noticed that some of our Voidworms tend to develop small cyst-like growths as they reach maturity. Further observation showed that specimens with these unsightly blisters are typically more fertile than their counterparts.

Additional research into this phenomenon may reveal a new element of Voidworm biology that can be enhanced to develop a species-specific mutation.

texts.zh:
我们对虚空虫的变异实验完成了，得到了一些有趣的繁殖周期变异：剧毒囊肿

我们已经能够提高这些生物用来轰炸宿主星球的寄生囊肿的繁殖能力。结果是产生的若虫产量增加。
texts.en:
Our experimental mutation project on Voidworms is complete, and has yielded some interesting variations of their reproductive cycles: Virulent Cysts

We have been able to increase the fertility of the parasitic cysts these creatures use to bombard their host planets with. The result is an increase in yield of generated nymphs.

texts.zh: 我们对[From.GetShipCategoryName]的克隆工作取得了基因突破。将这些生物独特的解剖结构与我们在基因操控方面的专业知识结合起来，或许可以创造出一种独特的变异体。

note.en: In the game, the category name of this creature appears here.

texts.zh:
由于过度投喂，我们记录到了一只克隆岩居兽发生了剧烈的呕吐。从其胃部喷出的消化液作为浓缩抛射体非常致命，即使在离开该生物的躯体很长时间后还保有放射性。

对这一现象的进一步研究揭示了岩居兽的生理学中有一种新的元素可以用来增强物种特有变异过程。
texts.en:
As a result of overfeeding, one of our cloned Cutholoids was recorded violently ejecting the contents of its stomach. The resulting digestive fluids proved to be quite deadly as a concentrated projectile, maintaining their radioactive qualities for significant time outside of the creature's body.

Additional research into this phenomenon may reveal a new element of Cutholoid biology that can be enhanced to develop a species-specific mutation.

texts.zh:
我们对岩居兽的变异实验完成了，得到了一个有趣的结果：胃袋喷泉

我们已经找到方法能将其巨大消化系统改造为发射高初速长射程弹药的武器。不幸的是，这一显著的生物学改造会导致它们无法再吞噬敌方舰船了。
texts.en:
Our experimental mutation project on Cutholoids is complete, and has yielded some interesting results: Gastric Fountain

We have found a way to repurpose their massive digestive system to fire high velocity, long-range projectiles. Unfortunately, this significant biological modification will mean they are no longer able to engulf enemy fleets.

texts.zh: 我们对[From.GetShipCategoryName]的克隆工作取得了基因突破。将这些生物独特的解剖结构与我们在基因操控方面的专业知识结合起来，或许可以创造出一种独特的变异体。

texts.zh: 在战斗测试中，一些我们的晶体实体在被摧毁后完美地分裂成两半。这些碎片保持着重要的生命迹象，并继续存活了一段时间。
texts.en: In combat testing, a number of our Crystalline Entities have split perfectly in two after being destroyed. These fragmented halves have maintained vital life signs and continued to live for a short time.

title.zh: 晶态实体变异计划完成

texts.zh:
我们关于晶态实体的变异实验完成了，得到了一些有趣的结果：分裂核心

通过对它们晶体基因的这种修改，每个生物在遭受严重创伤时能够分裂成两个独立的个体。这将极大地提高它们的战斗能力。
texts.en:
Our experimental mutation project on Crystalline Entities is complete, and has yielded some interesting results: Fissile Cores

With this modification to their crystalline genetics, each creature is capable of splitting into two independent organisms in the event of severe trauma. This should drastically improve their combat capabilities.

texts.zh:
我们已经从[FromFromFrom.GetShipSizeName]所在的[FromFrom.solar_system.GetName]星系中获得了该生物的遗传物质。

虽然我们目前无法克隆这种生物，但我们仍然可以从其独特的生物学特性中提取宝贵的见解。
texts.en:
We have recovered the genetic material of the [FromFromFrom.GetShipSizeName] we encountered in [FromFrom.solar_system.GetName].

Though we lack the understandings to clone such a creature, we may still be able to extract valuable insight from its unique biology.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现巨型生物所在星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the system where the giant was found appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这种生物的体型名称。
note.en: In the game, the size name of this creature appears here.

texts.zh: 我们从缇扬奇族母身上提取的遗传物质为我们提供了一些独特的见解，这将使我们能够进行一项实验性突变项目，该项目可以应用于任何太空兽群。
texts.en: The genetic material we have recovered from the Tiyanki Matriarch has provided some unique insight that will allow us to proceed with an experimental mutation project that could be applied to any Space Fauna.

texts.zh:
我们使用缇扬奇族母的遗传物质进行的变异实验完成了，得到了一些有趣的结果：自我再生酶

族母遗传物质中存在的修复酶可以在其他生物的类似腺体中复制。这将它们的结构组织转化为再生材料，在爆炸时紧密编队中会非常有用。
texts.en:
Our experimental mutation project using Tiyanki Matriarch genetic material is complete, and has yielded some interesting results: Restorative Enzymes

The restorative enzymes present in the Matriarch's genetic material can be reproduced in similar glands on other creatures. This transforms their structural tissue into regenerative material, which would provide quite useful in tight formations upon explosion.

texts.zh:

虽然我们目前无法克隆这种生物，但我们仍然可以从其独特的生物学特性中提取宝贵的见解。
texts.en:
We have recovered the genetic material of the [FromFromFrom.GetShipSizeName] we encountered in [FromFrom.solar_system.GetName].

Though we lack the understandings to clone such a creature, we may still be able to extract valuable insight from its unique biology.

texts.en: The genetic material we have recovered from the Voidspawn has provided some unique insight that will allow us to proceed with an experimental mutation project that could be applied to any Space Fauna.

title.zh: 虚空孳孽变异计划完成

texts.zh:
我们使用虚空孳孽基因材料进行的变异实验完成了，得到了一个有趣的发现：星养生理

这些生物的组织对星光反应强烈，可以被鼓励在其他生物体中生长。这需要少量能量来维持，但在最亮的恒星附近，它们的生长速度会大幅提高。
texts.en:
Our experimental mutation project using Voidspawn genetic material is complete, and has yielded an interesting discovery: Starborne Biology

The tissue of these creatures reacts strongly to starlight, and can be encouraged to grow in other organisms. This demands a small amount of energy to maintain, but vastly improves their growth rate near the brightest stars.

summary.text:
# 先进可控变异：独特变异计划 / Advanced Controlled Mutations: unique mutation projects

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/grand_archive_events.txt, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt, common/inline_scripts/grand_archive/mutations/unique_mutation_trigger_check_case.txt · DLC：Grand Archive · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

隐藏事件 grand_archive.10000 挂在 on_ship_built（common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:2559）：国家拥有“先进可控变异”科技时，每建成一艘该国的太空生物船，就按船型大小累计该种类（太空变形虫/缇扬奇/虚空虫/岩居兽/晶体生物）的总产量；累计达 250（@unique_mutation_space_fauna_special_project_clone_threshold，07_scripted_variables_grand_archive.txt:179）且尚无同类项目时，设置标记并触发对应事件（10005–10009）。
Hidden grand_archive.10000 (on_ship_built) adds up built space-fauna ships per kind once the country has Advanced Controlled Mutations; at 250 it fires the matching event (10005-10009).
另有两条击杀线：on_ship_destroyed_perp（common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1475）在击毁长者缇扬奇（leviathan_01_elder_tiyanki）或虚空之子（leviathan_01_voidspawn）后触发 10055 / 10075（需大档案馆DLC、同一科技，且尚未掌握该变异）。
Two kill lines: destroying an Elder Tiyanki or a Voidspawn fires 10055 / 10075 (on_ship_destroyed_perp).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 每条线：触发事件（唯一选项“好极了”）→ 启动特殊项目 <种类>_UNIQUE_MUTATION_PROJECT → 项目完成后完成事件（10010 太空变形虫、10015 缇扬奇、10020 虚空虫、10025 岩居兽、10030 晶体生物）→ 授予科技 tech_unique_mutation_<种类>。
  Each line: trigger event -> special project -> completion event grants tech_unique_mutation_<kind>.
- 10055 → 项目 tiyanki_matriarch_UNIQUE_MUTATION_PROJECT → 10060 授予“恢复酶”变异；10075 → 项目 voidspawn_UNIQUE_MUTATION_PROJECT → 10080 授予“星生生物学”变异。
  10055 -> project -> 10060 gives Restorative Enzymes; 10075 -> project -> 10080 gives Starborne Biology.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 七条线互相独立（可全部发生），不是互斥分支。 The seven lines are independent, not alternatives.
- 每种类只会触发一次（项目进行中或已达阈值标记则不再触发）。 Each kind triggers once (project running or threshold flag set).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 必须拥有大档案馆DLC与“先进可控变异”（tech_controlled_mutations_2）。 Requires the Grand Archive DLC and Advanced Controlled Mutations.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：grand_archive.10000-10080 的触发、阈值与调用的 on_action；inline_script unique_mutation_trigger_check_case。
- 更正 Corrections：原先 10000、10055、10075 分成三个故事，现并为同一系列；结构（触发→项目→科技）本就正确。
  The three stories are merged into one series; the compiled trigger->project->tech structure was already right.
